menu.footerTagline: Beauty courses taught by working professionals.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.lead: Money for your courses reaches your bank account through Stripe, our payment provider.
payouts.notConnectedTitle: Your payout account isn't connected yet
payouts.notConnectedText: Give Stripe your details and bank account. It takes a few minutes, and then you can sell paid courses.
payouts.unfinishedText: Stripe still needs a few details. Pick the form up where you left off.
payouts.inReviewText: This usually takes from a few minutes to two days. If Stripe needs anything else, it will email you.
payouts.readyTitle: All set, you can take payments
payouts.readyText: Money from your courses goes to your Stripe account and from there to your bank automatically.
payouts.errorText: We couldn't reach Stripe. Refresh the page or try again in a moment.
payouts.finePrint: You give your bank details and documents to Stripe directly. Bellademy never sees or stores them.

assistant.example1: Which manicure courses are there in Kraków?

assistant.example3: Did my last payment go through?
